text.p: Finalists for the
WTA Tour's 1996 annual awards, to be awarded on March 19 at a
Gala in Miami, Florida:
Player of the Year
Martina Hingis and Steffi Graf
Doubles team of the Year
Martina Hingis/Helena Sukova, Lindsay Davenport/Mary Joe
Fernandez, Jana Novotna/Arantxa Sanchez Vicario
Most Improved Player of the Year
Irina Spirlea, Karina Habsudova, Martina Hingis
Most Impressive Newcomer of the Year
Patty Schnyder, Henrieta Nagyova, Anna Kournikova
Comeback Player of the Year
Meredith McGrath, Barbara Paulus, Jennifer Capriati
Karen Krantzcke Sportsmanship Award
Sabine Appelmans, Amy Frazier, Yayuk Basuki
Player Service Award
Mariaan de Swardt, Marianne Werdel Witmeyer, Katrina Adams
Aces Award
Gabriela Sabatini, Arantxa Sanchez Vicario, Monica Seles
